Reconstructed exact base/head diff contains only the five handoff-listed paths. No renames, deletions, unrelated source or canonical-record changes; candidate remains clean and whitespace checks pass.

Closed registry has no network retrieval callback; unknown fields and unsupported versions fail. Plan-local identities are qualified. One recomputed digest governs approval without stale-hash fallback. Both candidate and fresh installed import origins were independently checked.

Handoff accurately records recognition limits, public signatures, dependency closure, acceptance and preserved recovery lineage. Independent exact-head runs support its behavioral claims.
